formulas.description: Calculates based on the Credential selected if the provider record should use the Physician record type.
formulas.name: formulaRecordType
formulas.expression: CASE({!Credentials}, "APRN", "Clinical Extender", "FNP", "Clinical Extender", "FNP-BC", "Clinical Extender", "NP", "Clinical Extender", "PA", "Clinical Extender", "CNM", "Clinical Extender", "Physician")
